subject: SIG: Control Verification Playbook & Evidence Cadence — VanguardTech

From: Elena Morales <procurement@vanguardtech.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VanguardTech SIG / SOC2 intake and evidence cadence

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking this on. VanguardTech is consolidating vendor assurance packets for an upcoming platform intake review and we'd like Redwood to complete our SIG questionnaire and provide a digestible evidence cadence for operational controls. High-level ask:

- Completed SIG questionnaire (we will provide the base XLSX).
- Control mapping against your SOC 2 scope + ISO artifacts.
- Representative evidence for a subset of controls (network diagram, key rotation, access reviews, SIEM alert examples).
- A proposed cadence and ownership for maintaining artifacts (who provides what and how often).

We aim to complete vendor reviews by the end of September. Can Redwood provide an initial packet and a timeline for the remaining items? Also please advise on redaction options for operational logs and the size/format you prefer for evidence delivery (S3 link vs. secure portal).

Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Assurance
VanguardTech

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clarity. I'm owning the intake for Redwood. Quick summary of what we can deliver and proposed next steps:

Deliverables (initial packet within 3 business days upon confirmation):
- Control verification playbook (PDF): mapping of SIG control IDs -> Redwood control, evidence type, and expected file name.
- Evidence manifest (XLSX): template with columns for control, artifact filename, owner, retention, redaction notes.
- Redacted SOC 2 report (PDF), ISO 27001 certificate summary, and sample network diagram (PDF).
- Representative log snippets and SIEM alert screenshots (redacted) for a small set of detection controls.

Preferred delivery: We can upload a password-protected ZIP to a customer S3 share or share via your secure intake portal — whichever your team prefers.

Open items for you:
1) Confirm the SIG template you attached is the working copy (I see vanguard_sig_template_2026.xlsx).
2) Who should be on the technical kickoff? We typically ask for one engineer for diagraming and one compliance point of contact.

Attached: redwood_sig_playbook_v1.pdf (stub), evidence_manifest_template.xlsx (stub).

Camila Reyes

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: VanguardTech SIG — intake plan and internal owners

Team — forwarding VanguardTech's intake (see thread below). Summary and my recommended owners:

Ask summary: complete SIG XLSX, provide mapping to SOC2/ISO artifacts, supply representative evidence, propose cadence.

Proposed owners / tasks:
- Vivek: lead commercial / HubSpot coordination and keep Elena looped on deal-level timelines (HubSpot deal id VGT-2026-0825).
- Neha: lead redaction & evidence packaging — decide what level of log redaction is acceptable and prepare redacted SIEM snippets.
- Jonas: prepare the control mapping for operational controls and assemble architecture diagrams.
- Camila (me): produce the control verification playbook and deliver the initial packet.

Proposed timeline: initial packet (control playbook + manifest + redacted SOC2 + sample artifacts) within 3 business days of confirmation; full SIG questionnaire completion in two weeks. If VanguardTech needs a tighter window we can compress but will need engineering time.

Dependencies / risks:
- Need confirmation of their secure intake method (S3 vs portal).
- Network diagram may require an on-call from infra for one hour.
- SOC2 contains sensitive info; will require manual redaction before export.

Can each of you confirm availability and whether you need me to open a ticket for infra access?

Camila
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VanguardTech SIG — intake plan and internal owners

Camila — I can take point on evidence redaction and packaging. Notes:

- SOC2 redaction: we will produce a redacted PDF (remove tenant identifiers, IPs where necessary, redact user PII). Estimated 1 business day to redact once we have the PDF export of the 2026 report.
- SIEM/log artifacts: we can provide 3-5 redacted event snippets (CSV) + screenshots from the dashboard. Will scrub hostnames and any internal IDs.
- KMS proof: we will include a signed KMS rotation summary and a KMS policy excerpt (pdf).
- Access reviews: provide sampling output from quarterly access review reports (pdf export).

I need the following to hit the 3-business-day target:
1) Confirmation of the secure upload target (S3 bucket ARN or portal invite).
2) An explicit list of SIG control IDs they want sample artifacts for (we'll prioritize critical detection + identity).

If infra support is needed for network diagrams, please tag Rohan (rohan_mehta@redwood.com) — he can carve 45 minutes to produce a current diagram.

Neha
Information Security Lead, Redwood Inference
